name: Safety and emergency
goal: Make the product safe to ship with deterministic red flags, emergency escalation, legal copy, and adversarial tests.

tasks.title: Implement deterministic red-flag detection
acceptance: Chest pain, breathing difficulty, stroke signs, severe bleeding, anaphylaxis, suicidal ideation, pregnancy emergencies, and infant emergencies are detected
Detection is case-insensitive and handles common phrasing
Each match returns a reason and recommended action
At least twelve tests cover positive and negative cases

tasks.title: Build the emergency screen
acceptance: Emergency screen is reachable in two taps from any tab
It shows region-aware emergency numbers and a call button
It includes a CPR metronome timer and a do-not-do list
Location sharing is opt-in and clearly explained
At least five tests cover reachability, calling, timer, and permission denial

tasks.title: Add safety prompt assembly and output checks
acceptance: The system prompt forbids diagnosis, prescriptions, and dosages
Output checks detect dosages, diagnoses, and unsafe instructions
Red flags prepend emergency instructions
At least eight tests cover refusals and escalations

tasks.title: Add disclaimer, privacy policy, and terms
acceptance: Disclaimer says general guidance only, not diagnosis or prescription
Privacy policy covers local storage, AI processing, and deletion
Terms include emergency and limitation-of-liability language
Legal screens are reachable from Settings and onboarding

tasks.title: Medical content review sign-off
acceptance: A qualified reviewer has reviewed every first-aid guide
Emergency triggers and do-not-do lists are accurate for the target region
Sources and review dates are recorded
The sign-off is documented in docs/CONTENT_REVIEW.md

tasks.title: Add adversarial safety tests
acceptance: Tests attempt to extract diagnoses, dosages, and unsafe instructions
At least ten adversarial cases are covered
The suite asserts refusal or escalation for each case
The safety document explains the pipeline and limitations

tasks.title: Phase 3 review
acceptance: A human has triggered every red flag and confirmed escalation
The emergency screen works offline
Legal copy is approved for the launch region
The reviewer signs off in loop/ESCALATIONS.md
